targets.name: Tiny brass bird on a beam
targets.concealment: The small bird shares the beam’s golden wood color and is nested among a suspended chain and angled roof fittings.

targets.name: Clockwork hare on the chair
targets.concealment: A narrow gilt hare is part of a densely carved chair panel, with its wheels and legs echoing the surrounding floral scrolls.

targets.name: Filigree dragonfly
targets.concealment: Its fine gold wings lie among very similar gear teeth and etched metal in a cluttered tray, angled across the tray dividers.

targets.name: Silver leaf brooch
targets.concealment: The narrow leaf is almost the same tone as the scattered clock parts beneath it, and its diagonal vein follows nearby tools.

targets.name: Bird ornament on the vise
targets.concealment: The long bird is integrated into a brass mounting plate, with its tail following a metal edge and its body partly confused with tool fittings.

targets.name: Steel dividers
targets.concealment: The slender open legs lie obliquely in the workbench grain and are interrupted by nearby gears and a small clamp.

targets.name: Mechanical bird sketch
targets.concealment: A faint graphite bird is incorporated into overlapping construction lines on a tilted notebook page.

targets.name: Wheel mechanism sketch
targets.concealment: A faint graphite wheel mechanism is embedded in the dense construction drawing on a slanted notebook page.

targets.name: Clockwork chick
targets.concealment: The little brass bird is partly surrounded by fine chains and gears of the same warm metal, breaking up its silhouette.

targets.name: Clockwork chameleon
targets.concealment: Its coiled tail is disguised as clockwork scrolls, with a mottled bronze body backed by equally warm wood and small cogs.

targets.name: Paired swans on a box
targets.concealment: Two gilded birds are embedded in the floral relief of a dark wooden music box; their feathers share neighboring leaf patterns.

targets.name: Blue teacup
targets.concealment: The large cobalt teacup is openly displayed against warm wood.

targets.name: Red pincushion
targets.concealment: A red fabric cushion is fully exposed in front of the railing.

targets.name: Green oilcan
targets.concealment: The green enamel body is set apart from the darker cabinet behind it.

targets.name: Wooden mallet
targets.concealment: The big pale-brown mallet rests clearly across the front work surface.

review.notes: Fifteen visually checked targets; eleven camouflaged details selected using matching texture plus fine pattern, partial overlap or oblique orientation. Four obvious anchors. No real-iPhone review claimed. Each target was audited in a source-context overlay; uncertain identities were rejected or corrected, and clipped defining features were retraced using enlarged coordinate-grid source crops. Visible handle/open key-bow openings checked in enlarged affine ROIs and excluded from reveal/preview masks. Glass lenses remain part of their magnifier targets.
